konu: Sacculina barnacle turns crabs into zombie caretakers

en.baslik: The Parasite That Turns Crabs Into Zombie Babysitters
en.aciklama: Sacculina spreads root-like tendrils through a crab, sterilizes it and makes it care for the parasite's eggs. Even infected males start acting like females.

tr.aciklama: Sacculina paraziti yengecin içine kök salar, onu kısırlaştırır ve kendi yumurtalarına baktırır. Enfekte erkek yengeçler bile dişi gibi davranmaya başlar.

cumleler.tr: Bu yengeç neden yabancı yumurtalara bakıyor?
cumleler.en: Why is this crab tending strange eggs?
The culprit is a parasite, Sacculina.
Its roots spread through the whole body.
The crab can no longer breed.
Then a sac appears under its belly.
It's full of the parasite's eggs.
The crab thinks they're its own.
It cleans them and gives them air.

cumleler.tr: Dişi gibi davranıp yabancı yumurtalara bakar.
cumleler.en: Act like females and tend strange eggs.
